text.name: Migration Crises
text.rules: Record "a million arrivals". Until the end of this turn, points spent by LIO count 1 less, never below 1. If "proxy war" has been recorded this game, LIO spends nothing at the end of this turn; otherwise, at the end of this turn, LIO spends 1 point.
text.history: In 2015 just over one million refugees and migrants reached Europe by sea, more than 800,000 of them via Greece, and about half of them from Syria; at least 3,700 died or went missing at sea. By 2024 more than 7 million people had left Venezuela since its economic collapse began in 2014, most of them for other Latin American countries.
